notes.title: Chapter 1 Final Version + New Trailer + BIG showcase
notes.notes:
[h1][b]We are back![/b][/h1]

The time of demo and beta testing is finally over. Thanks for all those who took the time to test and write detailed feedback! You helped significantly into improving the final game.

[b]The last version for the first chapter of Word To Angel is now available![/b] After long weeks of hard work and testing, it's finally here. The full introduction chapter of the game with all its features and content exactly how it'd be in the finished game.

Here's a list of all the main features that's been added to complete it:

- Rework of the music minigames' design and system with now a bypass option for people who dislike rhythm games or find them too difficult

- Main menu + saving system and checkpoints throughout the whole chapter

- Rework of Deci-Bell's boss battle

- Addition of the Voiding Room (Kickstarter's stretch goal) - Try pressing E on the apartment bed both before the Deci-Bell boss battle and after!

- Full ending (more dialogues and interactions) - In order to finish the chapter, try checking the gate down the park after beating Deci-Bell

- New easter egg

- New songs - Try checking the music player before and after beating Deci-Bell

- Many details and bugs fixing

This chapter will stay available at all time and for free until the full game releases. The full game will have 6 chapters in total, and the 6th will be the longest. The first chapter is the shortest as it is the introduction though expect all other chapters in general to be definitely longer.

We can now move on from the first chapter and continue working on the rest.
[b]
The full game is expected to release in summer 2026.[/b]
We'll continue to collect feedbacks, of course. Feel free to share your experience of playing through the demo by joining (if you haven't already) the Discord server.
We will be releasing patches if needed for any bug fixing and future feature changing, according to you guys' feedback.

[b][url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wT1EkcorwH0]To watch the new gameplay trailer on YouTube.[/url][/b]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wT1EkcorwH0
[b][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/coolkidroy/word-to-angel]You can still get the many rewards left and support the project at the same time thanks to late pledges on Kickstarter.[/url][/b]

[b][url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6pyhrMLpAZk]Word To Angel is featuring in INDIE3: Clemmy's BIG (Best Indie Games) Summer Showcase today, accompanied with a Steam event.
[/url][/b]

Make sure to wishlist and share the game page/demo to your friends! This will really help. Thanks for everything! Love.

notes.title: Play Word To Angel - Chapter 1 Demo now!
notes.notes:
[h3]The full and finished first chapter of Word To Angel is now available on Steam![/h3]

We collected all of your feedbacks then implemented them, as well as new features and details we couldn't finish in time before. So, even if you've already played the first version of the demo, please give this one a try, as it is new and now complete.

This demo will stay available at all time and for free until the full game releases. The full game will have 6 chapters in total, and the 6th will be the longest. Like twice or three times the lenght of this one. The first chapter is the shortest as it is the introduction though expect all other chapters in general to be definitely longer.

[b][i]Important: Even if there are checkpoints in-game, the demo doesn't have a save system yet, so be careful and don't quit it accidentally while expecting it to save automatically or something. This could be added in the future through an update but note that saving will of course be present in the full game.[/i][/b]

I'm so excited to see everyone's reactions to it and we'll continue to collect feedbacks, of course. Feel free to share your experience of playing through the demo by joining (if you haven't already) the [url=https://discord.com/invite/ycQfdzdK3f][b]Discord[/b][/url].

You can still get the many rewards left and support the project thanks to late pledges on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/coolkidroy/word-to-angel][b]Kickstarter[/b][/url].

Still reading? You're a real one. Word To Angel will be featured in Steam's upcoming Next Fest at the end of February, so make sure to wishlist and share the game page/demo to your friends! This will really help. I will make a new post with more details specifically about this event prior to it. So... Stay tuned, as always!

notes.title: Project successfully funded 185% on Kickstarter! Thank you!
notes.notes:
[h3]What a way to leave 2024. Such an interesting, surprising and creative year for me. Hope your [b]2025[/b] will be [b]likewise![/b] [/h3]

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/coolkidroy/word-to-angel][b]You can still back and get rewards! Late pledges are on.[/b][/url]

Thanks to 32 generous backers, we've collected over €2,000! With a set goal of €1,111! It may not seem much for some but for me, just to think that some unknown people have decided to believe and invest into my project is unbelievable.
Also massive thanks to all those who didn't have money to give but sent their warmest support and shared the project, regardless.

The two stretch goals that were beaten will be worked on then included in the final game!
I can't wait to amaze all of you with the upcoming epicness regarding the game! But before that, I will take care of the rewards.

Take important care of yourselves and happy new year!
